Privacy.metaDescription: What the portfolio assistant collects, why, how long it is kept and how to ask for deletion.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: This page covers the site’s conversational assistant only. The rest of the site collects nothing personal.
Privacy.collectedBody1: When you write to the assistant, the conversation is stored: your questions and its answers. Many people mention who they are or what they are looking for — so it is treated as personal data.
Privacy.collectedBody2: No IP address is stored. To limit abuse, a technical fingerprint is derived from your address, but it is salted with a secret and rotates daily: it cannot be traced back to the address, nor used to follow you from one day to the next.
Privacy.whyBody: Conversations are used to improve the assistant and to understand what visitors expect from the site. The “helpful / not helpful” feedback you can leave on an answer is kept with the conversation it belongs to, always anonymously.
Privacy.retentionBody: Conversations are kept for thirty days, then deleted automatically. None is kept beyond that.
Privacy.rightsBody: Because a conversation is tied to no identity, it cannot be found from your name. If you would still like an exchange deleted before its deadline, write to me from the contact page with something to go on (the date, the topic) and I will take care of it.
